title: geoidep 0.4.0
text: Full refactor: scripts reorganised provider (inei.R, geobosque.R, serfor.R, mtc.R, sernanp.R, inaigem.R, senamhi.R, mapbiomas-alerta.R, mapbiomas-lulc.R, mapbiomas-fire.R); dead MIDAGRI/SIGRID code removed. CRAN compliance: timeouts every internet request, network examples moved \dontrun{}, tests skip gracefully offline/CRAN, vignette builds without internet access. Dropped dependencies: httr, progress, geojsonio, glue; progress bars now use cli/httr2::req_progress(). New: MapBiomas Peru Collection 4 support get_mapbiomas_peru_lulc(). Geobosques backend migration: legacy geobosques.minam.gob.pe/.../ws/rest API offline (HTTP 404), get_forest_loss_data() now queries current Geobosques platform (bosques-app.pe, GET /api/forest-loss/wet-forest-list?ubigeoCode=). arguments output columns (anio, perdida, rango1-rango5, ubigeo), now 2001-2025 wet-forest series district, province department level. Vignette: section 6 now compares Loreto province departmental mean faceted line chart.
